name: datapipelines
description: Author, run and debug declarative SQL pipelines on a datapipelines.co deployment. Ships the datapipelines agent skill and connects Claude Code to your deployment's MCP server.

url.title: Deployment URL
url.description: The base URL of YOUR datapipelines deployment, with no trailing slash — for example https://dp.example.com, or http://localhost:8080 for a local ./app.sh --start. This product is self-hosted: there is no default endpoint.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: A user-kind API key from your deployment's /settings/api-keys page, of the form dpk_<id>.<secret>. Ask for the LOWEST scope that covers your work: read to inspect, execute to run, author to create or change. No MCP tool needs admin.
